name: superpowers
skillInstructions: Optional Kimi Code tool mapping when using a Superpowers skill: AskUserQuestion for structured questions when useful; TodoList for task tracking when needed; Agent for explicitly chosen delegation; Skill for on-demand skill loading; Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, FetchURL, and WebSearch for the corresponding operations. Read a referenced prompt template before using it. Skills are advisory; ordinary questions and simple edits can be handled directly.

interface.shortDescription: Planning, TDD, debugging, and delivery workflows for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Use Superpowers to guide agent work through brainstorming, implementation planning, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel execution, code review, and finish-the-branch workflows.
